subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Bribery and Corruption
description: A quick, practical guide to Bribery and Corruption.

hook.text: A construction firm pays a city official $2 million. They win a $200 million contract. Coincidence?

buildup.text: Corporate bribery pays officials to win contracts, bypass regulations, or avoid penalties.

discovery.text: The Foreign Corrupt Practices Act makes it illegal for U.S. companies to bribe foreign officials.

twist.text: Despite the law, bribery remains common — companies simply get more creative at hiding it.

climax.text: FCPA fines have exceeded $2 billion in a single year. Companies still calculate bribery as a cost.

punchline.text: When the fine costs less than the contract, bribery pays for itself.

quiz.question: What does the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act prohibit?
